title: GopherCon 2014 Inside the Gophers Studio with Blake Mizerany
summary: A GopherCon 2014 session where Blake Mizerany replaced his planned talk with a panel discussion with members of the Go team. It covers Go's design choices and community questions.
why: HN commenters cite it as a source for what Go team members said about language regrets and Go's adoption.
